auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: 1. Non-provision for expected credit loss on trade receivables of Rs 7.74 crore (X7,74,37,115) per Ind AS 109. 2. key_risks: Trade receivables overstated by Rs 7.74 crore due to non-provision of expected credit loss
Inventory existence and valuation unverified due to missing stock records
Unprovided interest liability to MSME vendors
Unprovided gratuity liability due to absence of actuarial valuation
